settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure environment files and service restarts.

deploymentMode.img: Restart follows the image mode declared in config.toml: it pulls the latest images, then recreates the containers without rebuilding.
deploymentMode.src: Restart follows the source mode declared in config.toml: it rebuilds the images from source, then recreates the containers. This is much slower and replaces the images that are running.
deploymentMode.unresolved: config.toml [admin] does not declare a readable DEPLOYMENT_TYPE, so restart pulls images and does not rebuild. Set DEPLOYMENT_TYPE to "img" or "src" there to make this explicit.

groups.title: Groups Management
groups.subtitle: Create and manage permission groups.
groups.name: Name
groups.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this group? This action cannot be undone.
groups.noGroupsDescription: Create a group to get started.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.subtitle: Browse and inspect every recorded action in the system.

docs.title: CMS Documentation
docs.subtitle: Comprehensive guide to the Contest Management System.

destructive.title: Delete this {noun}?
destructive.description: This permanently deletes the {noun}. This cannot be undone.

removeParticipant.title: Remove this participant?
removeParticipant.description: This permanently removes the participant's entry from this contest. This cannot be undone.

removeTaskFromContest.title: Remove this task from the contest?
removeTaskFromContest.description: The task is unassigned and is not deleted; it can be added to the contest again.

markTestUser.title: Mark this user as a test user?
markTestUser.description: The participant becomes hidden and unrestricted. Both flags can be changed back in the participation settings.

recalculate.title: Recalculate this submission ({type})?
recalculate.description: Current results are cleared and recomputed from the submission, which is kept.

fullServerUpdate.title: Run a full server update?
fullServerUpdate.description: This pulls the latest images, restarts all services and updates the database schema. The server is unavailable for a few minutes.

restartStack.title: Restart {label}?
restartStack.description: The affected services restart and are unavailable until they come back up.

pullImages.title: Pull the latest images?
pullImages.description: Images are downloaded from the registry without restarting the running services. This may take several minutes.

rebuildStack.title: Rebuild {label} images from source?
rebuildStack.description: Images are rebuilt from the current source without restarting the running services. This may take 5-10 minutes.

manualBackup.title: Trigger a manual backup now?
manualBackup.description: All submissions are backed up in the background; the server keeps running.

deploy.watchingStoppedDescription: The panel stopped watching this deploy. It keeps running, and the contest is updated when it finishes.

maintenance.backupTriggered: Backup triggered in background. Check Discord for status.
maintenance.notificationsSaved: Notification settings saved to config.toml and .env.
maintenance.notificationsSavedMonitorRecreated: Notification settings saved and the monitor was recreated.
maintenance.monitorRestartFailed: Settings saved, but the monitor restart failed: {error}

discord.testAlertDescription: Test alert sent from the admin panel. Delivery is working — monitor alerts (CPU, memory, disk and container events) will arrive here.
discord.configTomlMissing: Could not update {configToml} — run './cms config sync' once so the value has a source of truth, then retry.
discord.noWebhookUrl: No webhook URL to test — enter one and save it, or set DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL in config.toml [infra].
